name: Read supporting document
description: Optional, read-only action for inspecting one previously uploaded and confirmed supporting file that is missing from chat. Call it only with the exact basename, including extension; the file name is resolved inside the server-owned Supporting documents folder for the caller's current or resumable completed interview. It cannot read other folders or arbitrary files and is not attached to the agent by default.

inputFields.label: Supporting file name
inputFields.description: The exact basename, including extension, of a previously uploaded and confirmed supporting file in this interview (for example, Process-Checklist.pdf). Do not provide a path or URL.
